name: Aundh
civicNote: Within PMC limits; PMC's Smart City Pune project covers Aundh-Baner-Balewadi.
summary: An established, largely self-contained residential neighbourhood in north-west Pune, along University Road and the Mula river.
knownFor: Site of the 1817 Battle of Khadki, fought at the old Aundh village
Long-established residential area with its own retail and services
Part of the Aundh-Baner-Balewadi Smart City area
connectivity: University Road connects Aundh to Shivajinagar and central Pune
Rajiv Gandhi Bridge over the Mula links Aundh to Sangvi
Pune Metro Line 3 runs along nearby Ganeshkhind Road, opening in phases from November 2026
suits: Families and professionals who want an established neighbourhood with ready amenities, close to both the city centre and the western IT belt.
